events.headline: WARY ALLIES SHOW THERE'S NO QUICK FIX TO TRUMP'S IRAN CRISIS
events.detail: European leaders are hesitant to help Trump secure the Strait of Hormuz, but they know inaction on the Iran war is not really an option.

events.headline: TRUMP ASEGURÓ QUE EL RÉGIMEN IRANÍ FUE “ANIQUILADO” Y SE MOSTRÓ MOLESTO CON LOS
events.detail: El mandatario norteamericano dijo estar frustrado por la falta de “entusiasmo” de “numerosos países”, tras los rechazos a unirse a una coalición para asegurar el estrecho de Ormuz

events.headline: TRUMP NO DESCARTA TOMAR LA ISLA PETROLERA IRANÍ DE KHARG MIENTRAS LA GUERRA DISP
events.detail: El bloqueo del estrecho de Ormuz y los ataques en el Golfo Pérsico sacuden el mercado energético mundial; Washington insiste en formar una coalición naval para garantizar el tránsito de petroleros

events.headline: EUROPEAN LEADERS REJECT MILITARY INVOLVEMENT IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: Pushback comes as US President Donald Trump says NATO allies should help secure key waterway amid soaring oil prices.

events.headline: QATAR CALLS ON IRAN TO STOP GULF ATTACKS, URGES DIPLOMATIC SOLUTION
events.detail: Qatar foreign ministry spokesman Majed al-Ansari accuses Iran of targeting civilian areas as he calls for de-escalation.

events.headline: IRAN HITS KEY UAE OIL PORT AND DUBAI AIRPORT
events.detail: The port of Fujairah plays a crucial role in helping keep global supplies moving when the Strait of Hormuz is blocked.
